nom: ROUND LAB Vita Niacinamide Glow Capsule Cream

avis.titre: A Korean Moisturizer That Plays Nicely with Most RoutinesA Korean Moisturizer That Plays Nicely with Most Routines
avis.texte: This is a non-greasy moisturizer that works quite well to diminish dark spots. See two photos. You be the judge. This is about 5 minutes after application. The cream is gentle and didn't create any irritation. It has virtually no smell and rubs in very easily like a lot of Korean products. It has a cute design and is made in South Korea. The active ingredient in this is niacinamide (i.e., Vitamin B3) and 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (a derivative of Vitamin C), which are generally considered safe for daily use. If you already use a strong Vitamin C serum (especially L=ascorbic acid at high percentage), adding this Vitamin C derivative could increase the risk of irritation.

avis.titre: Hydrating but hasn't reduced dark spots
avis.texte: Very moisturizing but in 2 months, I haven't seen any difference in dark spots on my face. It's lightweight and makes my skin soft so I will continue using but unless I see a reduction in dark spots by the end of the tube, I would not repurchase as the product is expensive for just a moisturizer. I will say this -- if you're sensitive to niacinamide like I am, this formula is VERY gentle and I haven't experienced irritation like I have with other niacinamide products.
Helps my dark spots. it's safe for my sensitive skin compared to some other brightening creams I've tried. That's just my personal experience
Se siente excelente al aplicarla, llevo poco usandola espero ver resultados.

avis.titre: Using this for melasma.Using this for melasma.
avis.texte: I have dark age spots near my eyes. My wife has melasma on her forehead and upper lips now, from playing pickleball a lot in the sun. We're both using this to hopefully even out our skin tone. We've been using it for a few months now, and I feel like it has definitely helped with my eye areas. On my left side, you can see some dark age spots. They are also on my right side. But, on the right side, they seem quite diminished now. I've been putting this cream just on my right side to test out the difference, and it's definitely noticeable. In terms of moisturization, and skin protection, I feel this is a good lotion. However, there are lots of other good lotions that have excellent absorbency and hydration. Better than this product. But, we're using this mostly for its skin lightening effects.
Doesn't irritate skin and feels nice on skin. Moisturizing and promotes glowy skin
Seems like a slow process. Bought it to reduce melasma. Spots haven’t gone away but haven’t worsened either.

avis.titre: Suitable for dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the moisturiser for a few weeks. While I noticed it’s moisturised my skin and brightens it but it doesn’t really lighten my age spot much. Maybe I have to use the full range of their products?
